text:
ryan: hi all :wave: ryan here, starting on infra today. quick checklist questions: 1) who maintains the authoritative service owners list (and is it machine-readable)? 2) i'm blocked on SSH to the jump host (ssh: permission denied) and 3) if a pager fires before i'm fully onboarded who do i page? thanks!

sam (eng-platform): welcome ryan! the canonical owners list is in Confluence -> Team Directory -> Owners (we publish a JSON export at https://redwood.internal/api/owners.json). eng-platform is the steward for infra metadata.

people-ops: @ryan i'll add you to Confluence and the owners group now. DM me your employee email so i can kick off badge + VPN requests. temporary badges via facilities@redwood.com (same-day usually).

ryan: thanks — for the jump host i ran `ssh -J jump.redwood.internal` and got "permission denied (publickey)".

sam (eng-platform): sounds like your SSH key wasn't uploaded to the org. run `gh ssh-key add ~/.ssh/id_rsa.pub --title "ryan-laptop"` or upload via the UI. if that fails, i'll open an org-admin ticket.

infra-bot: automated: owners-export updated 2026-03-10T09:12Z by sam. link: https://redwood.internal/api/owners.json

sre-oncall: if you see a prod alert before PD access: 1) post in #eng-oncall with subject "coverage request - <service> - <short reason>", 2) include whether you can join console, 3) someone will pick it up. If no ack in 10m, escalate to EM oncall listed next to the service in the owners JSON.

kate (eng-manager): adding that your manager is the fallback — page me directly if it's customer impacting and SRE/EM can't be reached. i'll coordinate and make sure coverage is assigned.

ryan: perfect. one more: where's the codeowners file for infra repos? want to see who owns which deployment manifests.

sam (eng-platform): codeowners live in each repo under `.github/CODEOWNERS`. for a cross-repo view we have an index in the owners JSON under `repo_codeowners`. ping me and i'll share a short script to map services -> codeowners.

ryan: awesome, appreciate it. i'll accept the invites and follow up if anything else blocks. :thumbsup:
